title: October 22: the living paper, self-discovered conjunctions and real-image wall
summary: Three independent October 22 image mechanisms: SihtiImageModel5 carries a confidence-weighted remembered image across occlusion, detects foreign pasts and fails the full precommitted memory-inside-energy advantage; ClaudeRepo1 rectifies Sihti bands, corrects its non-independent photographic holdout and shows twenty toy learners can self-select a triple by masked self-prediction, while conventional ridge controls still tie on supplied features; ModelImage progresses from a jigsaw to genuinely absent-pixel generation and hierarchical competitive residues, yet its held-out natural photographs are better completed by plain interpolation. Synthetic successes and source-audit corrections are preserved; this is not a natural-image generative model or a demonstrated biological learning law. Results and receipts were read from upstream; this atlas did not rerun them.

nodes.claim: Adds motion-aligned, confidence-weighted persistent image state and a likelihood-ratio consistency gate to Model 4's frozen local patch energy; tests identical-last-frame twins, foreign history and memory-as-energy versus simple history pasting.
nodes.survived: Under 48 long and 48 short held-out-image sequences, remembered history changes completion under identical last images (twin own-truth closer 100%). Foreign history is switched off to match the last-frame-only answer; long-hole MSE is 0.0000764 versus 0.000106 for pasting remembered pixels. History-conditioned response to a local ping is about 23x smaller, an exact model operator check.
nodes.killed: The full preregistered H3 gate fails: short-hole paper/paste ratio 0.980, confidence interval 0.88-1.03, not <=0.97. Patch-state improvement H1b misses +10-point gate (79.2% to 88.6%). Changes entirely hidden behind the occluder cannot be detected; static scenes, translations, tiny grayscale photographs and known noise prevent cortex/world-model claims.
nodes.era: October 22: memory changes the medium only when believed

nodes.claim: Tests nonlinear rectified cross-scale image relations, memory-dependent completion and the discovery of three-piece conditional structure by self-predictive competition and rewiring; provides a readable browser world and an unrun natural-image logical-anomaly inspector.
nodes.survived: A1 nonlinear rectified relations separate real crops from phase-scrambles (AUC 0.87 versus signed 0.50). A controlled contrastive-association world gets the same visible image right under two learned histories, but pixel ridge ties. A supplied three-way feature gets 100% while pairwise features get 50%. Subsequently 20/20 rewiring learners discover a three-slot eye-eye-mouth relation on synthetic glyph worlds (median 250 observations), achieve 100% covered-mouth accuracy, versus approximately 50% for the linear pairwise control.
nodes.killed: A2 typicality gate fails (AUC 0.40). A2b's 0.78 fresh-source claim is withdrawn: skimage cat aliases training chelsea. Untrained all-ones weights tie learned coactivation on one discrimination; contrastive ridge also ties learned associations; a supplied product solves parity trivially. World demo uses known 3x3 slots, glyphs and fixed noise; natural-photo inspector is specified, not benchmarked on MVTec LOCO. Fast/slow persistence Gate B was not built.
nodes.era: October 22: experience identifies a missing conjunction in a toy world

nodes.claim: An inspectable browser image assembler advances from shuffled 6x6 tile assignment to generated missing 16x16 motif patches and then competitive coarse/mid/fine residue codebooks with spatially flexible support hypotheses, visible-patch self-check and held-out natural-image tests.
nodes.survived: V1's learned assignment improves over untrained seam-only jigsaws on exploratory face/city synthetic examples. V2's truly masked synthetic mouth completion scores 100/100 per world versus 50/100 for one-support controls after 360 scenes, without the hidden target entering inference. V3 has exact additive 2x2->4x4->8x8 transforms before learned quantization; a synthetic shifted-support fixture improves from rigid 2/4 to flexible 4/4. Trust gating refuses low-quality real-image proposals.
nodes.killed: On 24 masked tests from four entirely unseen photographs, V3 two-support MSE 0.03756, one-support 0.03222 and simple interpolation 0.00916; trust chooses interpolation in all 24. On 60 synthetic V3 tests the two-support complete model 0.09019 also loses to interpolation 0.05814. Garden jigsaws are unstable; patch dictionaries and coarse-only conditionals do not yet learn transferable object geometry, scale, or high-frequency detail. Synthetic V2 success is not natural-image generation.
nodes.era: October 22: transparent generative machinery meets a real-image ceiling

edges.why: Model 5 explicitly vendors Model 4's frozen local patch-energy machinery and adds state transport, trust and a history energy term.
ClaudeRepo1 explicitly takes Sihti Model 5's living-paper intuition into a browser experiment and tests whether nonlinear relationships among Sihti scale bands require learning.
ModelImage's README explicitly identifies the ClaudeRepo1 higher-order experiments as motivation, then learns fragments and relations with separate browser engines; it is not a code fork.

ModelImage explicitly draws on the SihtiImageModel5 lineage and implements a different held-out visible-patch trust check in its V3 generative completion architecture; the check is not a port of Model 5's likelihood ratio.

motifs.title: Remembered visual history must earn trust from what is visible
motifs.description: Persistent image memory can make the same last frame imply different hidden content. Model 5's likelihood-ratio trust check blocks incompatible history, but unobservable scene changes remain undetectable and simple pasting almost ties memory inside the energy on partly unseen holes.

motifs.title: Discover the useful conjunction instead of handing over the product
motifs.description: Three-way parity is inaccessible to ordinary linear/pairwise features yet trivial when a cubic feature is supplied. ClaudeRepo1's bounded self-prediction rewiring discovers the relevant three-piece group on synthetic glyph worlds; ridge with supplied features and scaffolding remain essential controls.

motifs.title: A learned synthetic visual alphabet is not natural-image transfer
motifs.description: ModelImage learns relocatable atoms and conditional patch completion in small synthetic worlds. Its three-band competitive V3 transforms are invertible before quantization, but learned reconstruction loses to untrained interpolation on held-out photographs; multiscale alignment and conditional fine detail remain missing.
